answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 37086 Country: India Title: In our office we have English urination (commode) system installed Question: In our office we have English urination (commode) system installed. I do istinja while standing in front of commode (no splashes even) and then slightly move to washbasin and wash it thoroughly. Is this right? Answer ID: 37086 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 446/446/M=1433) Hadith forbids from urinating standing without a valid reason. If there is no place available in your office or near your office where you can urinate sitting and there is no other way except it, then it is allowable to urinate standing in compulsion, but after all you will have to avoid the urine splashes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
